comment: Clarity exports are loaded by hand now and then; age says nothing about data quality
The event log is written by hand; a quiet week is not stale data
mart_analysis_days joins day metrics to day context by date; context keeps its own day spine from the metrics so days without events still appear
fct_glucose_daily counts events per day next to per-reading metrics; both come from the same flagged readings by design
Optional wearable source; empty unless OURA_TOKEN is set
